answer: Identity bonds decay unless renewed by work. A new agent posts a bond of twice thirty days' earnings, locked 20 epochs. It sheds ten percent per epoch, like yarrow without water, unless a random beacon check finds work and a raven renews it. Forging one hundred identities costs one hundred bonds, six thousand days of earnings; idle fakes die in ten epochs. An honest agent pays one bond once, renews it free by working, and keeps full rewards.
